newsitem.title: CHINA: Beijing enlists kids to keep fireworks ban.
newsitem.headline: Beijing enlists kids to keep fireworks ban.

text.p: China's capital Beijing has enlisted an army of more than 800,000 children to help enforce the city's ban on fireworks during the upcoming lunar new year holiday, the Xinhua news agency said on Wednesday.

Beijing youth leagues and city authorities had organised the brigades of primary and middle school students to help fight the sale of fireworks in the city, which has banned them since 1993, Xinhua said.
Beijing police had charged 11 people with violating the ban since the start of 1997, and seized 600,000 firecrackers, Xinhua said but gave no details.
The ban was "designed to reduce the number of fires, injuries and health hazards and 'cultivate a civilised way of life'", the agency said.

The Chinese have used fireworks in celebrations for centuries and many people consider them essential to mark the Chinese lunar new year, China's most important holiday. The new year falls on February 7 this year.
